newsitem.title: USA: Nortel, Omnipoint in phone deal.
newsitem.headline: Nortel, Omnipoint in phone deal.

text.p: Nortel (Northern Telecom) on Tuesday said it has entered into and agreement with Omnipoint Corp under which Ominpoint will supply Nortel's wireless mobile phone handsets.
Financial details were not disclosed, but Nortel did refer to the pact as a multi-million dollar agreement.

Nortel said the new deal with Omnipoint builds upon a previous agreement. In 1994, they signed a five-year supply agreement for personal communications network equipment and services for the New York area and other potential Omnipoint operating areas, Nortel said.
